content.short: CoinStats is a crypto portfolio tracker for monitoring wallets, exchange accounts, DeFi positions, and market data.
content.description: CoinStats is a portfolio dashboard for crypto investors. Users connect wallets and exchange accounts, track assets, follow market prices, and monitor DeFi positions from one interface, which makes it useful for TON holders managing broader portfolios. CoinStats is the leading crypto tracker on the market. Track over 20000 coins, 300 exchanges/wallets across 120 blockchains from a single platform. Its practical role is market access and trading support rather than protocol ownership or wallet storage.
